items.computation: The invoice is dated 17.12.2025 (a Wednesday). The payment term runs '7 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum' (7 days after the invoice date). Per Sec. 187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period is stated as running from ('nach') the triggering date, that date itself is not counted; counting starts on 18.12.2025 (day 1). Day 7 of the count falls on 24.12.2025 (18,19,20,21,22,23,24 December). 24.12.2025 is a Wednesday and is not a statutory public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so no extension under Sec. 193 BGB applies. Due date: 24.12.2025.
